indicators.name: SBOM File Creation
indicators.pattern:
title: SBOM File Creation
id: 9c5b1a3e-4f8d-4b1e-8c7a-9d0f1b3e4c5d
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of a Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) file, typically named sbom.json. This is an informational rule indicating software supply chain security practices are in place, as recommended by CISA guidance.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/news/cisa-guide-helps-federal-agencies-securely-and-effectively-use-open-source-software
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-07-30
level: informational
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '\sbom.json'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the creation of SBOM files, a practice recommended in the CISA guidance for managing OSS security.

indicators.name: SECURITY.md File Creation
indicators.pattern:
title: SECURITY.md File Creation
id: 8b4a2c1d-5e9c-4a2d-9b8a-8c7d6e5f4b3a
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of a SECURITY.md file, which outlines a project's security policy and vulnerability disclosure process. This is an informational rule indicating secure development practices as recommended by CISA guidance.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/news/cisa-guide-helps-federal-agencies-securely-and-effectively-use-open-source-software
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-07-30
level: informational
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '\SECURITY.md'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the creation of SECURITY.md files, a best practice for OSS production mentioned in the CISA guidance.
